Compact WSON/VSON/SOT-563 packages demand tight hot-loop layout and thermal vias.
A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Provides transient overshoot margin above nominal DC supply bus.
Fixed-output variants save divider BOM; adjustable parts allow arbitrary rail tuning up to switch BVdss limits.
For boost/switch-limited converters, usable Iout ≈ Isw × (Vin / Vout) × η minus half ripple ΔIL/2.
Dominates light-load efficiency and standby battery runtime.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS61023DRLR uses SOT-563 (6-pin, DRL) while TPS610994DRVR uses WSON-6 (6-pin, DRV); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VIN vs FB), Pin 4 (GND vs EN), Pin 6 (VOUT vs VIN). Soldering TPS610994DRVR onto a TPS61023DRLR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (SOT-563: NONE vs WSON-6: GND); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.

CRITICAL FEEDBACK LAYOUT DIFFERENCE: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; adding or removing the external R1/R2 feedback divider and feedforward capacitor requires a PCB layout change.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS61023DRLR: 1 µH p.4 vs TPS610994DRVR: 2.2 µH p.4); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS61023DRLR specifies 3700 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5) vs TPS610994DRVR 1000 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5). Remember boost/switch-limited Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle and inductor ripple scaling.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 99% higher on TPS61023DRLR (TPS61023DRLR: 142.7 °C/W p.4 vs TPS610994DRVR: 71.7 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: TPS61023DRLR (Texas Instruments, SOT-563) and TPS610994DRVR (Texas Instruments, WSON-6) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VIN vs FB), Pin 4 (GND vs EN), Pin 6 (VOUT vs VIN); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VIN vs FB), Pin 4 (GND vs EN). Power-stage deltas: boost (sync) vs boost (sync), switching frequency 1000 kHz (p.5) vs 1116 kHz (p.16) (1.1x ratio), typical inductor 1 µH (p.4) vs 2.2 µH (p.4), output mode adjustable vs fixed, and package θJA 142.7 vs 71.7 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS61023DRLR "1.8 V Minimum Startup Voltage Despite 0.5 V Running Floor" (p.5) and TPS610994DRVR "Pin 3 (FB) MUST Connect to GND on Fixed 3.3 V TPS610994 (Opposite of TPS61221)" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose TPS61023DRLR when higher switch current capacity (3700 mA) is required; choose TPS610994DRVR when light-load battery standby needs 1 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
